Official Henan public map portal returned HTTP 200 from a Chrome-like direct GET and was opened in the public web reader. It presents vector map, satellite imagery, terrain, developer WEB service/API and data API; not parcel cadastral vectors.

Official Zhengzhou bureau notice says land-use entities can sign in with real-name provincial government accounts and download vector data / parcel maps (宗地图) using land-transfer contract or allocation decision numbers. This is authenticated, transaction-specific access, not an anonymous public parcel feed.

Official Dajindian township master-plan notice publishes land-use and urban planning maps as linked JPG image attachments and states detailed content is available from the Dengfeng planning bureau; images are planning maps, not cadastral parcel polygons.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: No city-specific open parcel scope verified in this research pass. Country-level evidence is not attributed to this urban centre.
coverageAssessment.finding: Coordinates resolve to 大金店镇 (Dajindian Town), Dengfeng City, Zhengzhou, Henan. Official Dengfeng registry notices document rural-house real-estate registration in Dajindian; the municipal government lists the town administratively. No anonymous parcel polygon response with stable native identity was verified. Follow-up verified that the official Zhengzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau links its public TianDiTu portal; Henan TianDiTu responds with public vector basemaps, imagery, terrain and developer APIs. Dengfeng publishes township planning maps as JPG attachments. Zhengzhou also documents a real-name, contract-number-specific parcel-map/vector download workflow. None of these sources provides verified anonymous target-area parcel polygons with a stable parcel ID.

nextStep: Treat Henan TianDiTu as a basemap/API aid only. The strongest parcel-map source is Zhengzhou’s authenticated transaction-specific download workflow; public planning attachments are raster JPGs and not suitable parcel geometry. No login was attempted. Revisit only if an official anonymous cadastral layer/catalogue is found.
